item.title: 'One-positron cyclotron' could test a key prediction of the Standard Model
item.description:
📚 Physics News
The positron is the antimatter counterpart of the electron, identical in mass but carrying an equal and opposite electric charge. Like the electron, it also behaves like a tiny bar magnet, and according to a key prediction of the Standard Model of particle physics, its magnetic moment should be exactly equal and opposite to the electron's.

item.title: Spatiotemporal proteomics reveals dynamic antiparallel gradients shaping signalling waves
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Wilke H. M. Meijer, Virginia Andrade, Suzan Stelloo, Wouter M. Thomas, Marek J. van Oostrom, Balaji Srinivasan 等14位作者
Nature Communications, Published online: 25 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78911-0 Researchers map rhythmic protein changes in developing mouse embryos and reveal how dynamic, antiparallel RSPO3 and LGR4 patterns shape signalling waves that control the formation of body segments contributing to the spine.
